before.known: I want to ask you about your friend
before.target: je veux te demander à propos de ton ami

after.known: I want to ask you something about your friend
after.target: je veux te demander quelque chose à propos de ton ami

problem: Grammar: demander lacks the thing being asked.
evidence: The seed and siblings use à propos de ton ami as a topic. Demander à propos de without a question/object does not express asking someone about that topic.

before.known: I don't understand about your friend here
before.target: je ne comprends pas à propos de ton ami ici

after.known: I don't understand what you said about your friend
after.target: je ne comprends pas ce que tu as dit à propos de ton ami

problem: R8: incomplete, context-dependent English; French also lacks what is not understood.
evidence: Unlike the seed and the complete U02/U07 siblings, this says neither what about the friend is unclear nor what is not understood.

evidence: The seed and siblings refer to the content of an utterance already made. Waiting for what he said has no ordinary reading here.
